notes.title: Demo Results & Roadmap
notes.content:
It may seem like the investigation has come to a halt... but that only means we're preparing something truly big! We're excited to share some important news and our plans for the future.

As promised, the first players who successfully completed the demo will receive a full game key. To our surprise, there were more of you than we expected! Watching you play and reading your feedback, critiques, and kind words has been incredibly rewarding for us. We truly appreciate every single one of you!

A special thanks to our streamers—your broadcasts have helped us understand our audience better and refine our vision for the project. You won’t be left empty-handed: streamers will receive game keys for personal playthroughs or giveaways for their communities (or maybe both? Keep an eye out!).

Thanks to your reports, the demo was continuously improved throughout the festival—from minor fixes to major quality-of-life enhancements. This game is evolving because of our combined efforts.

[h3]Now, let’s take a look at what’s ahead![/h3]

You are about to experience a gripping story, where your role goes far beyond that of a simple investigator. Prepare to explore unexpected locations, face difficult moral choices that could jeopardize everything, and navigate through three chapters packed with some of the most intricate and immersive puzzles—many inspired by real-life investigation techniques. Ciphers? Over time, they’ll become second nature to you. But what if I told you that you’ll need to learn how to code? Or perhaps conduct scientific experiments and tests?

We can’t wait to share all of this with you inside the full game. Thank you for sticking with us—your support means everything! 💙
